digest.component_or_area: ticket admission gates and P4 evaluation
propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding a configurable maximum (default 8,000 characters) must block both plan-review and completion-verification gates before any runner calls.
Plan-review DET blocks must partition so that only a blocking P4 description finding flows into the deterministic short circuit; other DET blocks downgrade to advisory.

Completion verification must check the authoritative description against the [verify] setting immediately after loading and before child checks, returning a deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls if exceeded.
Exactly 8,000 characters is permitted; 8,001 or more characters triggers the block.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; no truncation or summarization of ticket content is allowed.
